title: At what angle does a throw go farthest?
question: At the same speed, in which direction does a throw go the farthest?
steps: Pull the ball back to set the direction.
Let the ball go and watch its path.
Start again and compare with another angle.
observe: See the curve made by the sideways speed and the downward acceleration together.

terms.name: Velocity
terms.description: Which way and how fast a thing moves.

terms.name: Acceleration
terms.description: How quickly the speed changes over time.

terms.name: Projectile motion
terms.description: The curved path a thrown thing makes while gravity acts on it.

law.title: Motion of a thrown object
law.description: While it moves sideways, gravity adds downward speed, so it moves in a curve.

tip: Press the ball, pull it back and let go: it flies the other way. The pull's direction is the throw angle. The ball always flies at the same speed. Set the throw height under Change the conditions.
tip_short: Pull the ball back and let go to throw

predict.question: If you throw low, where will the ball land?

choices.label: Very far
choices.guess: I think it'll go very far!

predict.reason: Thrown low with the same strength, the ball comes down to the ground soon. So it lands close.
predict.bridge: Throw it and see for yourself!

stages.text: Throw low and hit the near box!
stages.say: The ball always flies with the same strength. Gravity pulls the ball down. Thrown low, it comes down soon. So it reaches the near box.
stages.win: Thwack! You hit the near box!
stages.miss: Throw it lower! It's the near box!

stages.text: How slanted should you throw? Hit the far box!
stages.say: Thrown at a slant, the ball goes both forward and up. It flies the farthest and reaches the far box.
stages.win: Boom! The far box fell over too!
stages.miss: Throw it slanted, right in between!

stages.text: Throw high and hit the box in the tree!
stages.say: Thrown high, the ball goes up a lot. Then it comes down close by. So it reaches the box on the high branch.
stages.win: Wow! The box in the tree fell down!
stages.miss: Not straight up! Throw it high and forward!

story.clue: If we hit the boxes one by one, I think the piece will come out!
story.map_clue: Something fell on the grass near the target!

kid.intro: This is the ball throw lab. A thrown ball flies forward. All the while, the ground pulls the ball down. This pull is called **gravity**. Let's see where the ball lands for each throw angle!
kid.title: Let's throw the ball far!
kid.say: The ball falls down while it goes forward. So it flies in a curve.
kid.tip: The ball flies the opposite way you pull. Pull down to throw it high!

note.law: At the same speed (8 m/s here), the closer the angle is to 45°, the farther it goes. Sideways it keeps the same speed, and downwards gravity pulls it.
note.learn: A thrown ball keeps its forward speed while gravity pulls it down, so it flies on a curve. Landing at the height it left from, a throw at about 45° goes farthest.
